title: Advisory re-scan at the promotion moment with an enforced freshness window
question: Implementation target: make the vulnerability gate decay-aware. A scan result is a query against a live advisory database, so last week's green says nothing about today's advisory set. Implement three properties: re-run the scanner against the exact artifact hash at the moment of promotion, record the advisory-database snapshot identifier and timestamp inside the receipt, and refuse to consume any stored result older than the declared window rather than reusing it.
